newsitem.title: USA: Stewart & Stevenson gets $35 mln in pacts.
newsitem.headline: Stewart & Stevenson gets $35 mln in pacts.

text.p: Stewart & Stevenson Inc said it has been awarded several new contracts totaling more than $35 million.

The company entered contracts with Nigerian AGIP Oil Co to provide support services to oil production facilities in Nigeria and Mobil Corp to provide support on database development for a computerized maintenance management system.

Stewart said other contracts include a five year deal to manage a Pluspetrol Energy-Central Termica de Tucuman power plant in Argentina and an operations and maintenance contract for a power plant set near Katherine, Northern Territories, Australia.
